professionalSummary.text: Has built and tested scheme message adapters against the scheme's certification simulator, running 412 test cases across three certification cycles.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and tested the scheme message adapters for the instant payments gateway in the bank's test environment and the scheme's certification simulator, running the 412 certification test cases against the simulator across three certification cycles.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated certification test windows with the scheme's certification desk and maintained test window logs and defect lists.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the certification test windows with the scheme's certification desk and kept the test window log and the defect list for each cycle.

professionalSummary.text: Documented integration limitations and hand-over conditions for release candidates through test evidence packs and hand-over notes.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the test evidence pack submitted for scheme certification and the hand-over notes for each release candidate, listing the simulator's known differences from the scheme and the open items for operations.

professionalSummary.text: Spent three years on the gateway program developing adapters, testing, coordinating certification, and documenting.
professionalSummary.witness: Roughly three years on the gateway programme covered adapter development, simulator testing, certification window coordination, test evidence packs and hand-over notes.

experienceHighlights.text: Operated in a test environment and simulator, not production; changes were reviewed by the payments operations engineering team for production deployment.
experienceHighlights.witness: The live scheme connection, the production releases and the production support rota were held by the payments operations engineering team; my changes reached them through the release review, and I held no production access.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided test evidence pack for certification cycle three with simulator run identifiers and defect list, and hand-over notes for release candidate seven.

skills.text: Scheme message adapter development and testing against certification simulator.
skills.witness: Built and tested the scheme message adapters for the instant payments gateway in the bank's test environment and the scheme's certification simulator, running the 412 certification test cases against the simulator across three certification cycles.
